findings.finding: An effective ATM (Ladenburg Thalmann, 424B5 re-supplemented 2026-09-24 with ~$9.8M available) is larger than the whole equity (~1.95M shares x $4.03 = ~$7.8M), so the issuer can sell into any bounce on 2026-10-02.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The registration is effective and the supplement is live, and this issuer draws repeatedly (four ATM supplements since 2025-05 per the baseline's text probe). Sales can happen during the 2026-10-02 session with nothing announced first, so they cap any rebound inside the window.
findings.resolves_by: 2026-10-02 — sales happen during the session; disclosure comes later, in the 10-Q
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 09-24 supplement the stock's next three comparable falls went -11.63%, -15.41% and -10.44% into the next close (baseline events 09-28 to 09-30). Of the baseline's last 12 drops, 3 closed higher the next session.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has repriced the overhang once, but an ATM larger than the market cap does not run out when the price falls: lower prices need more shares for the same dollars. If the market held it fully, a reversal-day prior of +0.4% (the cross-section) would not apply; this name's own history (median -1.66%, 36% up) is closer to how it trades.

findings.mechanism_in_window: Each exchange so far was disclosed within one or two sessions (8-Ks of 09-24 06:01, 09-25 17:36, 09-28 07:00). The exchanged holder can sell its 3(a)(9) shares on 2026-10-02, and a new exchange 8-K could post before the open.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sessions after the 09-24 and 09-28 exchange 8-Ks: 09-24 drop -20.76% then +9.07% next close; 09-28 -21.82% then -11.63%, and -15.41% and -10.44% on the next two days (baseline events).
findings.why_not_priced: The share count is public, but no remaining balance on the 2021 note is disclosed, so the market cannot see the tail of this supply. The holder's last basis ($7.06) is about 75% above spot, so the shares are not held for a price target. If the overhang were finished there would be an 8-K saying the note is retired.
